sql:
SELECT
  SUM(net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
FROM (
  SELECT
    members_src_10000.tier AS member__tier
    , subq_3.__net_sales_cents AS net_sales_cents
  FROM (
    SELECT
      member_id AS member
      , case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents - refund_cents else 0 end AS __net_sales_cents
    FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_src_10000
    WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  ) subq_3
  LEFT OUTER JOIN
    "data"."main"."members" members_src_10000
  ON
    subq_3.member = members_src_10000.member_id
) subq_8
WHERE member__tier in ('金卡')
answer: 在 2026 年 8 月（2026-08-01 至 2026-09-01）期间，青禾会员等级为金卡的 CRM 会员账户贡献的净销售额为 190.00 元。该统计口径基于已支付订单实付金额扣除退款后的金额汇总，取消订单不计入，并按原订单下单日期进行归属。
